# Contributing to Interactive 3D GPA System

First off, thank you for taking the time to contribute! 🎉 Contributions, issues, and feature requests are always welcome.

## How Can I Contribute?

### 1. Reporting Bugs
Before creating bug reports, please check existing issues to avoid duplicates. When creating an issue, include:
* Your operating system and browser version.
* Step-by-step instructions to reproduce the issue.
* Console error logs if applicable.

### 2. Suggesting Enhancements
Feature requests are welcome. Open an issue detailing:
* The core problem you want to solve.
* Your proposed solution or architectural change.

### 3. Pull Requests
1. **Fork** the repository.
2. **Clone** your fork to your local machine:
   ```bash
   git clone [https://github.com/your-username/student-gpa-calculator.git](https://github.com/your-username/student-gpa-calculator.git)
